mapper.select: SELECT up.user_id, up.real_name, up.gender, up.age, up.user_phone, up.neighborhood_id, n.neighborhood_name, up.address_detail, up.custom_history, DATE_FORMAT(uc.move_in_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as move_in_time FROM user_profiles up INNER JOIN user_community uc ON up.user_id = uc.user_id INNER JOIN neighborhoods n ON up.neighborhood_id = n.id WHERE uc.community_id = #{communityId} AND uc.status = 1 AND uc.move_out_time IS NULL

SELECT ec.contact_user_id, COALESCE(up.real_name, ec.contact_name) as contact_name, up.gender, ec.contact_phone FROM emergency_contacts ec LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON ec.contact_user_id = up.user_id WHERE ec.user_id = #{userId} AND (ec.is_staff = 0 OR ec.is_system_add = 0)

SELECT up.user_id, up.real_name, up.gender, up.age, DATE_FORMAT(uc.move_in_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as move_in_time, DATE_FORMAT(uc.move_out_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as move_out_time, uc.id as record_id FROM user_profiles up INNER JOIN user_community uc ON up.user_id = uc.user_id WHERE uc.community_id = #{communityId} AND uc.status = 0 AND uc.move_out_time IS NOT NULL AND up.user_id NOT IN ( SELECT user_id FROM user_community WHERE community_id = #{communityId} AND (status = 1 OR move_out_time IS NULL) ) ORDER BY up.user_id, uc.move_out_time DESC

SELECT MAX(alert_level) as alert_level, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT alert_type ORDER BY alert_level DESC SEPARATOR '/') as alert_types FROM health_alerts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT mhd.disease_name FROM user_medical_mapping umm INNER JOIN medical_history_dict mhd ON umm.history_id = mhd.id WHERE umm.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT id FROM communities WHERE admin_user_id = #{adminUserId}

SELECT up.user_id, up.real_name, up.gender, up.age, DATE_FORMAT(uc.move_in_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as move_in_time, DATE_FORMAT(uc.move_out_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as move_out_time, uc.id as record_id FROM user_profiles up INNER JOIN user_community uc ON up.user_id = uc.user_id WHERE uc.id = #{recordId}
